outputs.name: ollama-real-evidence-terminal-v1
outputs.summary: Independent review corroborates a bounded live ADL Cloud Gemma turn, persisted conversation, LocalTrace and post-run Jaeger projection; explicitly records model-ID difference and UI/local-only boundaries.

residual_risks: The real turn proves one bounded read-only file response from gemma4:31b through the app's Ollama Cloud integration; it does not prove broader code inspection, file changes, job execution, validation of P1-02, provider-signed billing, or cost.
Do not describe Jaeger as an automatic in-request export or say the app UI contained the Jaeger link; the original state was local_only and projection happened after the run.
gemma4:31b-cloud was not tested as a generative model; only gemma4:31b was used.

verification.evidence: W01-W04 handoffs, dependency order, scopes and payload hashes validated with no warnings.

verification.command: GET http://127.0.0.1:8084/api/conversations/conv_144a84b37b604678a4fc6c60af55ef85; read exact SQLite rows via mode=ro
verification.evidence: HTTP 200; exact owner/project identity and two complete messages read back; SQLite row/messages/references match the API response.
LocalTrace hash matches W04. Jaeger HTTP 200 returns one OK agent.chat span whose bago.trace_id, model, provider and source match the LocalTrace; Jaeger screenshot hash matches W04.

verification.command: Compare W02 provider verification/catalog, W03 turn, W04 trace receipts and screenshots
